acceptance: The contract binds exact base, head, merge-base, OCR version, and configuration identity.
Every changed file appears exactly once in deterministic reviewable or excluded accounting, with exclusions carrying a reason.
Material excluded or unsupported files require explicit separate-review accounting rather than disappearing from coverage.
Semantic state distinguishes executed review from NOT RUN/BLOCKED and requires blocker evidence when not executed.
Every material semantic finding has a fixed, accepted-risk, false-positive, deferred-blocking, or unresolved disposition with rationale.
A changed material head invalidates stale semantic evidence unless an explicit deterministic reconciliation proves the reviewed diff is unchanged.
Negative fixtures reject duplicate/missing file accounting, stale head identity, missing blocker evidence, and unresolved material findings.

required: Contract schema/validator tests including negative file-accounting and blocker fixtures.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.
Recorded Alibaba OCR semantic blocker remains NOT RUN unless a scoped endpoint is genuinely provisioned.

minimality.rationale: Extend the existing Ineractive protocol package and canonical OCR procedure rather than introduce a parallel review subsystem.

requirements: Never convert NOT RUN, BLOCKED, generic-bot status, or agent self-report into semantic OCR PASS.
Never expose OCR LLM tokens or endpoint secrets in committed evidence.

outcome: Every OCR-attached change has deterministic exact-revision review evidence that accounts for every changed file, semantic execution or blocker state, rule resolution, findings, and dispositions without granting acceptance authority to OCR.
rationale: Canonical rolling-wave P00-S05-T02 frontier after SG-000006 deterministic OCR procedure completion.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000008 and OCR evidence-contract artifacts; no external review endpoint, secret, or product runtime side effect is introduced.

scope_in: Define a deterministic machine-readable OCR review evidence contract bound to exact base, head, and merge-base revisions.
Require complete changed-file accounting across reviewable, excluded, and separately reviewed material.
Record OCR version/config provenance and deterministic applicable-rule resolution.
Record semantic review execution plus structured findings, or an explicit truthful blocker when semantic review did not run.
Require disposition of every material finding and exact-head invalidation/reconciliation when the candidate changes.
scope_out: No substitution of CodeRabbit, cubic, Qodo, or another generic bot for designated OCR evidence.
title: IN-P00-S05-T02 Define OCR review evidence and file-accounting contract
